gate_rule: 2-of-3: CALL when >=2 instruments clear 0.95 the same way and none contradicts by >0.20 the other way; p_gate = median

instruments.market_source: Bookmaker outright odds, oddschecker.com PL page best price, fetched 2026-11-02 ~06:20 UTC (built-in browser), dated after MD9 incl. Liverpool v Arsenal 1-Nov; fractional 2/5, 8/1, 14/1, 16/1, 22/1
instruments.model_note: strength = games-played-shrunk PPG (k=12 prior games to league mean 1.37), fixed draw rate 0.24, 31 remaining games simulated independently, title by points then GD noise

quality_flags: THE DISAGREEMENT, DECODED (2026-10-23): the market favours Arsenal while our table model favours City - and it is not just stale odds. Polymarket prices a City POINTS DEDUCTION by June 2027 at 74.5% (charges verdict pending). Our model simulates the table as it stands and cannot see sanction risk; the market can. Until the verdict, the title race is genuinely open and this forecast stays WATCH.
Market odds (2026-10-20) predate MW8, where City lost at Villa and Arsenal drew level on points (both 21 at MD8); the model sees the MD8 table the market has not priced. Timing gap noted 2026-10-26.

Model simulates teams independently vs average opposition - no fixture list, no injuries, no schedule strength. It is a deliberate coarse instrument; 7 games of evidence get heavy regression to the mean.
Reference point (not an instrument): Opta supercomputer after MD5 had Arsenal 43.7%, City 39.8%.

rules: Champion = club ranked 1st in the final OFFICIAL table, including any points deductions, awarded results or sanctions applied before the table is confirmed (points-deduction rule: the sanctioned table is the real table)
'Winner from current top 5' resolves against the five clubs named in the question's entity list at freeze, not whoever is top-5 later
If the season is curtailed, rows resolve on the league's official champion declaration (incl. a PPG-decided table); no champion declared = VOID, logged and excluded from scoring
A title stripped retroactively AFTER first confirmation of the final table does not change resolution
resolution.source: Final official 2026-27 Premier League table (premierleague.com/tables) after the last matchday (~2027-05)
